import * as THREE from 'three';
import {OrbitControls} from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import {COLORS} from './board.js';
const mat=(color,extra={})=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.86,...extra});
const cream=mat(0xf2e6c7),wood=mat(0x876044),dark=mat(0x293e42),skin=mat(0xf5cfa2),steel=mat(0xacc7cd),leaf=mat(0x477b57),lightLeaf=mat(0x77974f),stone=mat(0xc9cbb8),gold=mat(0xf5d16e);
function mesh(g,m,x=0,y=0,z=0){const o=new THREE.Mesh(g,m);o.position.set(x,y,z);o.castShadow=true;o.receiveShadow=true;return o}
const ball=(r,m,x,y,z)=>mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r,12,8),m,x,y,z);
const box=(x,y,z,m,px=0,py=0,pz=0)=>mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(x,y,z),m,px,py,pz);
const cyl=(a,b,h,m,x=0,y=0,z=0,n=8)=>mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(a,b,h,n),m,x,y,z);
export function pieceModel(piece,owner){const g=new THREE.Group();const color=mat(COLORS[owner]);if(typeof piece==='number'){
 g.add(ball(.18,dark,-.17,.13,.12),ball(.18,dark,.17,.13,.12));g.add(cyl(.24,.32,.47,color,0,.45,0));g.add(ball(.31,skin,0,.92,0));g.add(ball(.045,dark,-.105,.96,.267),ball(.045,dark,.105,.96,.267));g.add(ball(.075,skin,0,.86,.30));g.add(ball(.12,skin,-.35,.55,.03),ball(.12,skin,.35,.55,.03));
 if(piece===1){g.add(cyl(.33,.35,.12,color,0,1.1,0));g.add(mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.29,.26,8),color,0,1.28,0));g.add(cyl(.027,.027,.85,wood,.4,.63,.02));}
 else{g.add(mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.335,12,8,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.53),steel,0,.98,0));g.add(box(.07,.24,.07,steel,0,1.02,.3));g.add(cyl(.028,.028,1.25,wood,.43,.8,0));g.add(mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.1,.27,4),steel,.43,1.52,0));g.add(cyl(.24,.24,.09,color,-.37,.56,.18,6));g.children.at(-1).rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
 if(piece>=3){g.add(box(.10,.31,.38,piece===4?gold:color,0,1.37,-.02));g.add(mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.38,.64,8),color,0,.55,-.15));}if(piece===4)g.add(cyl(.3,.3,.13,gold,0,1.23,0));}
 }else if(piece==='tree'){g.add(cyl(.07,.12,.65,wood,0,.33,0));g.add(mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.55,.8,7),leaf,0,.85,0),mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.43,.7,7),lightLeaf,0,1.23,0),mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.29,.58,7),leaf,0,1.57,0));}
 else if(piece==='palm'){const trunk=cyl(.065,.105,1.12,wood,.06,.6,0);trunk.rotation.z=-.13;g.add(trunk);for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/3;const l=ball(.42,i%2?leaf:lightLeaf,Math.cos(a)*.29,1.21,Math.sin(a)*.29);l.scale.set(1.4,.15,.45);l.rotation.y=-a;l.rotation.z=Math.cos(a)*-.28;g.add(l);}g.add(ball(.11,wood,.06,1.14,.05));}
 else if(piece==='castle'){g.add(box(.75,.58,.65,stone,0,.32,0));for(let x of [-.32,.32])for(let z of [-.28,.28]){g.add(cyl(.19,.21,.88,stone,x,.46,z));for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=i*Math.PI*2/3;g.add(box(.12,.17,.12,cream,x+Math.cos(a)*.13,.94,z+Math.sin(a)*.13));}}g.add(box(.17,.30,.02,dark,0,.22,.332));g.add(cyl(.023,.023,.62,wood,0,1,0));g.add(box(.3,.18,.035,color,.14,1.25,0));}
 else if(piece==='village'){g.add(box(.68,.56,.62,cream,0,.3,0));const roof=mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.61,.46,4),color,0,.8,0);roof.rotation.y=Math.PI/4;g.add(roof,box(.18,.3,.02,wood,0,.2,.32),box(.12,.12,.02,gold,-.22,.4,.32));g.add(cyl(.025,.025,.7,wood,.43,.7,0));g.add(box(.3,.2,.025,color,.58,.99,0));g.add(box(.13,.35,.16,stone,-.2,.88,-.15));}
 else if(piece==='grave'){g.add(box(.38,.48,.14,stone,0,.27,0));g.add(ball(.19,stone,0,.51,0));g.children.at(-1).scale.z=.4;g.add(box(.22,.05,.02,dark,0,.41,.085),box(.05,.23,.02,dark,0,.4,.085));g.rotation.z=-.12;}
 return g;}
export class BoardView{
 constructor(canvas,cells,onClick){this.canvas=canvas;this.cells=cells;this.onClick=onClick;this.scene=new THREE.Scene();this.scene.background=new THREE.Color(0x285362);this.scene.fog=new THREE.FogExp2(0x285362,.003);this.renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas,antialias:true,alpha:false});this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;this.renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;this.renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;this.renderer.setClearColor(0x285362);this.camera=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-35,35,25,-25,.1,220);this.camera.position.set(32,48,44);this.controls=new OrbitControls(this.camera,canvas);this.controls.enableRotate=false;this.controls.enableDamping=true;this.controls.dampingFactor=.12;this.controls.minZoom=.65;this.controls.maxZoom=4;this.controls.mouseButtons={LEFT:THREE.MOUSE.PAN,MIDDLE:THREE.MOUSE.DOLLY,RIGHT:THREE.MOUSE.PAN};this.controls.touches={ONE:THREE.TOUCH.PAN,TWO:THREE.TOUCH.DOLLY_PAN};this.controls.screenSpacePanning=true;this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff4d5,0x4c7180,2.5));const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe6b5,3.2);sun.position.set(-18,35,15);sun.castShadow=true;sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048,2048);Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera,{left:-36,right:36,top:32,bottom:-32,near:1,far:100});sun.shadow.normalBias=.06;sun.shadow.bias=-.0003;this.scene.add(sun);const sea=mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(400,400),mat(0x285562),0,-.72,0);sea.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;sea.castShadow=false;this.scene.add(sea);this.tiles=new Map();this.models=new Map();this.effects=[];this.highlights=new THREE.Group();this.scene.add(this.highlights);const tileGeo=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.974,.974,.32,6);const baseGeo=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.981,1.0,.43,6);const materials=COLORS.map(c=>mat(c));const bases=COLORS.map(c=>mat(new THREE.Color(c).multiplyScalar(.64)));for(const c of cells){const base=mesh(baseGeo,bases[c.owner],c.x,-.23,c.z);this.scene.add(base);const tile=mesh(tileGeo,materials[c.owner],c.x,.14,c.z);tile.userData.id=c.id;this.scene.add(tile);this.tiles.set(c.id,{tile,base});this.spawn(c,false);}
 // Tiny wave dashes give the ocean scale without cluttering the board.
 const waveMat=new
